Program.cs calls AddSigningCredential with the result of GetSigningKeyFromVault() and an algorithm (e.g. RS256)

assertions.rationale: The Phase 1 code does not call AddValidationKey; it appears only in prose/Phase 2 description.

assertions.rationale: Response labels this as Phase 1 and describes later phases.
